top_choice_rationale: P003 rewards a prediction followed by an experiment in the predicted regime: the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at the magic angle and the correlated insulating and superconducting states found by Jarillo-Herrero's group, reproduced by many groups with transport, scanning probes and spectroscopy. It opened a tunable platform for strong correlations, and the citation can stay silent on the unsettled pairing mechanism. Maturity (2018 experiments) and credit (Cao, Fatemi, Dean, earlier continuum work) are real weaknesses, so P001, the optical lattice clock with its clean two-name attribution and cross-checked 1e-18 record, is my close second and I would support it without reluctance.
recusal_note: No specific connection apparent from profile; my work on two-dimensional materials and electronic-structure theory is adjacent to the twisted bilayer graphene field, but no reported collaboration with the proposed laureates.
